source.title: Chaos Space Marines Faction Pack: Version 1.2

data.summary: While this model leads a unit, the **[Insane Bravery](vsdata:ability/core.insane-bravery)** Stratagem can target that unit for 0CP, even if that Stratagem already targeted another unit of yours this phase. Whenever you use this ability, destroy a Bodyguard model of that unit.
